bx = 0
by = 1
bbi = 1
eps = 1000000000

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    tx = (i * a) // b
    for j in range(-5, 6):
        t = tx + j
        tbi = b * i
        if abs(b * t - a * i) * bbi < eps * tbi:
            eps = abs(b * t - a * i)
            bx = t
            by = i
            bbi = tbi
